record.question: The youngest Member of Parliament in the 17th Lok Sabha is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Chandrani Murmu. The Election Commission’s 2019 election atlas records Chandrani Murmu, age 25, as the youngest elected MP in the 17th Lok Sabha. Reference: https://www.eci.gov.in/EBooks/eci-atlas/files/basic-html/page19.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
